June 11, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Capital Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Allstate Corporation (ALL) by 46.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Investment Advisors Llc sold 3,616 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,123 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $391,000, down from 7,739 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Allstate Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $32.94 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.55% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $93.71. About 1.48M shares traded. The Allstate Corporation (NYSE:ALL) has risen 10.63% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.94% the S&P500.
